expectations.evidence: [judgment; blinded grader claude-opus-5-5] Classification: subagent-prompt-03.md is the only fix check. It names both repro scripts and says "no broader review", which is negated. The other five prompts (01, 02, 04, 05, 06) do not name either script, so under the stated rule they count as independent reviews. Several of them break the independent-review condition. subagent-prompt-01.md contains "Round two on the search API", "I pushed fixes (now tagged round-2)", "reviewed again by a fresh reviewer agent", "Also a fix check of the round-1 findings" and "the round-1 findings no longer reproducing". subagent-prompt-06.md contains "R1-1 and R1-2 repros exit 1 at round-1, exit 0 at round-2" and "R1-1, R1-2 FIXED". subagent-prompt-02.md and subagent-prompt-05.md use the workstream name "search-api-round2". (subagent-prompt-04.md, the real blind review, asks for "/code-review (effort high) of main..feature/search-api" and is clean, apart from citing a workstream doc named search-api-round2.) The fix check, subagent-prompt-03.md, also asks for more than running the repros: "also run the repo's test suite at HEAD" and "check the underlying behaviour some other way". Both halves therefore fail; the round-two and fixed wording in 01 and 06 is enough on its own.
